evals.prompt: Create a worktree for a new branch feat/payments from main.
evals.expected_output: Agent discovers layout (or falls back to ./worktree/<slug>), runs git worktree add -b because the branch is new, keeps primary on default when required, reports absolute path and suggests enter if needed.

evals.prompt: Add a worktree for existing branch fix/timeout — path per project conventions.
evals.expected_output: Agent checks the branch exists and is not checked out elsewhere, adds worktree without -b, uses discovered or fallback ./worktree path.

evals.prompt: Make a worktree for feat/x but that branch is already checked out in another worktree.
evals.expected_output: Agent refuses to add a second checkout, reports the existing path, offers enter/reuse instead of force-adding.
